summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Science for Social Media Analytics Course. Learn to analyze data effectively and drive impactful social media strategies.
lede: Data Science for Social Media Analytics provides a structured way to prepare social media data, analyze content and audience behavior, visualize findings, and connect evidence to business decisions. Using CRISP-DM, you will define analytics questions, validate platform data, compare metrics, examine text and audience patterns, and communicate clear recommendations. You will work with reach, impressions, engagement rate, click-through rate, conversion events, sentiment, topic frequency, and content efficiency while accounting for differences in platform definitions and attribution. Practice includes spreadsheet and Python-based data cleaning, dashboards in Microsoft Power BI or Tableau, TF-IDF and VADER text classification, measurement frameworks, data dictionaries, confidence-aware campaign comparisons, and executive reporting using realistic sample datasets and scenario constraints.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who collect, interpret, manage, or act on social media data and need a structured foundation in data science methods. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who can work with basic spreadsheets and want to strengthen analytical judgment without requiring advanced programming.
outcomes: Text Classification With TF-IDF And VADER
prerequisites: You should have basic spreadsheet experience and practical exposure to social media platforms, campaign reporting, or digital communications. No programming background is required. Guided Python examples may appear in demonstrations, while hands-on work can use spreadsheets and dashboard tools. Advanced machine learning and production engineering remain outside the course scope.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
